title: How Does Your Phone Take Bright Photos in the Dark?
sources: Google Research blog, 'Night Sight: Seeing in the Dark on Pixel Phones' (Levoy & Pritch, Nov 14 2018): Night Sight captures up to 15 frames handheld (up to 1/15 s, or 333 ms with little motion) or 6 frames of up to 1 s on a tripod; frames are aligned, compensating for camera shake and scene motion, then averaged; merging multiple pictures reduces shot noise and read noise; motion metering shortens exposures when the phone or scene moves

Google Research blog, 'Astrophotography with Night Sight on Pixel Phones' (Kainz & Murthy, Nov 26 2019): on a tripod or other support, exposures up to 4 minutes on Pixel 4 (1 minute on Pixel 3/3a), split into at most 15 frames of up to 16 seconds each because longer frames make stars look like short line segments instead of points; individual frames are grainy but the averaged image looks much cleaner
MIT CSAIL / Durand, 'Denoising by averaging' (computational photography notes): random noise differs from frame to frame while the scene stays the same, so averaging aligned frames reduces noise
ScienceABC, 'Why are photos grainy in low light conditions?': in dim light the sensor collects few photons, so random noise becomes visible as grain

lines.text: How does your phone take bright photos in the dark?
lines.caps: HOW DOES YOUR *PHONE | TAKE *BRIGHT PHOTOS | IN THE *DARK?

lines.text: Well, at night the camera sensor catches so little light
lines.caps: WELL AT *NIGHT | THE CAMERA *SENSOR | CATCHES SO *LITTLE LIGHT

lines.text: that random noise shows up as grainy speckles.
So night mode doesn't take one photo.
It quietly snaps up to fifteen of them,
lines them up to cancel out your shaky hands,
lines.caps: LINES THEM *UP | TO *CANCEL OUT | YOUR *SHAKY HANDS

lines.text: The real details show up in every frame,
but the noise lands somewhere different each time,
That's why your phone tells you to hold still.
lines.caps: THAT'S *WHY | YOUR PHONE *TELLS YOU | TO HOLD *STILL

lines.text: And on a tripod, some phones keep going for four whole minutes,
lines.caps: AND ON A *TRIPOD | SOME PHONES *KEEP GOING | FOR *4 MINUTES

lines.text: in short chunks, so the stars stay sharp dots instead of streaks.
lines.caps: IN SHORT *CHUNKS | SO THE *STARS | STAY SHARP *DOTS | INSTEAD OF *STREAKS

lines.text: So your night photo is really fifteen photos in a trench coat.
lines.caps: SO YOUR *NIGHT PHOTO | IS REALLY *15 PHOTOS | IN A *TRENCH COAT
